description: Adds personality and delight to an interface: celebration moments, playful copy, illustrations, fun empty and loading states, satisfying interactions, easter eggs and sound. Use when the user wants a product to feel fun, charming, memorable or less joyless. Not for functional transitions and micro-interactions (use ui-animation).
